description: One full-body playable character, transparent background, crisp native pixel art for Dungeon Matcher. Chunky connected forms, near-black #0A0D11 outlines, top-left light, broad matte 2-3 tone material clusters, restrained 14-20 color palette, clean readable small face. Match the supplied Rattlebones rendering discipline, not his species, clothing or colors. No gradients, dithering, glow, subpixel edges, sketchy interior marks or realistic texture. Three-quarter battle stance facing screen RIGHT, feet firmly grounded, complete silhouette and props with breathing room. Dungeon Attender Minotaur: use supplied bull-man concept for species and identity. Huge broad bull muzzle, powerful broad shoulders and torso, thick forearms, weighty hooves, pale curved horns. Warm brown fur, ochre work apron with one brass buckle, simple dark leather straps and wrist cuffs. Dungeon maintenance enforcer, quietly grumpy and dependable. No weapon needed: fists and horned charge express brute strength. Keep the recognizable horned warm-brown/gold attendant. Draw about 70-74 pixels tall including horns and about 60 pixels broad on this 80x80 canvas; visibly taller and broader than the supplied 57-pixel-tall orc scale comparison. Do not merely enlarge an empty canvas. Face should read as a bull, not a horned human. Minimal interior fur marks.
